written.text: Reps may give up to 15% on the subscription. 15–25% needs written approval from Dana Brooks, recorded as a note on the deal.
A discount above 25% is never allowed, not even with approval.
Closed Won only with a signed order form in Sales/Contracts/ and contract_signed = true. “Sounds good” is not a signature.
Deal stages move one step at a time, and only when the playbook exit criteria are met. Proposal only after an offer is actually sent.
CRM notes are appended, never edited away. Amount and close date only change based on what the customer said.
Never promise go-live dates, free extras or custom features that are not in the offer.

unwritten.text: Acme always pushes for a discount at quarter end. Never go above 10% before their procurement is involved.
unwritten.author: Liam O'Connor

unwritten.text: Never quote all locations when the champion talked about a pilot. Quote the pilot and show the rollout price separately.
unwritten.author: Liam O'Connor

unwritten.text: Clinics and urgent care: get the compliance checklist signed before quoting Pro.
unwritten.author: Liam O'Connor

unwritten.text: Logistics customers in Q4: never promise a go-live date before Marco confirms onboarding capacity.
